test_plan.criterion: At least10 inspected candidates; every retained record has official publisher/operator status, geography/uncertainty, published access/schema-or-unknown, reuse status and check UTC.
Every claimed playable/live source has at least1 permitted actual timestamped playback/API proof plus media type/currentness. Iframe alone proves0.
0 private/unauthorized CCTV, auth bypass, host/stream enumeration, credentials, recordings, provider spend, automatic ingest or activation.
At least1 official catalog/API positive control or explicit failure. Compare publication/capture/check clocks and uncertainty for100% retained entries.

non_goals: private CCTV discovery or auth bypass
